Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football GPL 2026/27: Swedru All Blacks held by Berekum Chelsea in goalless draw Source : JoySports 15 November 2026 5:04pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Swedru All Blacks were held to a goalless draw by Berekum Chelsea in their Ghana Premier League encounter after failing to convert their opportunities.
The hosts started brightly and came close to breaking the deadlock in the 12th minute when Faisal Charwetey controlled a delivery beautifully on his chest before bringing the ball down to his feet.
However, his left-footed effort narrowly missed the target, with the forward coming agonisingly close to giving All Blacks the lead.
Neither side could find a breakthrough before the interval, despite four minutes of added time in the first half.
The second half followed a similar pattern, with both teams struggling to produce the decisive moment in front of goal.
All Blacks made their first changes in the 69th minute, introducing Stephen Baffoe and Samuel Osei Kofi for Charwetey and Zayat Bubakari in an attempt to inject fresh energy into their attack.
Prince Arthur was brought on for Latif Blessing in the 82nd minute as the hosts continued their search for a winner.
However, Berekum Chelsea held firm to secure a point, with the match ending goalless after 90 minutes.
The result leaves both sides with a share of the points after a contest in which neither could find the cutting edge required to claim victory.
